zh: 子数组的和等于两个前缀和之差，它能被 k 整除，当且仅当这两个前缀和除以 k 的余数相同。
从左到右计算前缀和的余数，记录每种余数第一次出现的位置。固定右端时，与它余数相同的最早前缀给出最长的合法子数组。
在字典里先放入余数 0 对应位置 0；依次累加元素并对 k 取模，得到第 i 个前缀的余数；若这个余数出现过，用 i 减去它首次出现的位置更新答案，否则记录它首次出现在 i；最后输出答案，没有合法子数组时就是 0。
en: A subarray sum is the difference of two prefix sums, and it is divisible by k exactly when those two prefix sums have the same remainder modulo k.
Compute prefix-sum remainders from left to right and remember where each remainder first appears. For a fixed right end, the earliest prefix with the same remainder gives the longest valid subarray.

Put remainder 0 at position 0 in a dictionary. Add the elements one by one modulo k to get the remainder of prefix i; if this remainder was seen before, update the answer with i minus its first position, otherwise record i as its first position. Print the answer, which stays 0 when no valid subarray exists.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Record the position where each prefix-sum remainder first appears; the range between two prefixes with the same remainder is a valid subarray.

## Correctness

The difference of two prefixes is divisible by k if and only if their remainders are the same. For a fixed right end, the earliest prefix with the same remainder gives the longest length; scanning all right ends and taking the maximum gives the optimum.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
